newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Eurotel tops 100,000 GSM customers - US West.
newsitem.headline: Czech Eurotel tops 100,000 GSM customers - US West.

text.p: Czech mobile telephone network operator Eurotel Praha sro, has topped the 100,000 client mark for its GSM Digital service, a partner in the Eurotel joint venture, US West International, said on Thursday.

In a statement issued from its headquarters in London, US West International, a unit of US West Media Group, said Eurotel's GSM network, launched mid-year, now reaches 74 percent of the population and 64 percent of Czech territory.

Eurotel, a joint venture along with Czech fixed-line monopoly SPT Telecom a.s., and U.S. partner Bell Atlantic Corp, has over 63,000 customers on its older analogue NMT network which covers 95 percent of the population.
US west said Eurotel's GSM tariffs were roughly in line with their NMT rates. It said the GSM service now included roaming agreements with 24 countries throughout central Europe and Scandanavia.

Since September Eurotel has been competing for GSM clients with RadioMobil sro, a joint venture of Czech transmission company Ceske Radiokomunikace a.s., and a consortium led by Germany's Deutsche Telekom AG.
Comparative client results for RadioMobil's GSM service, called Paegas, were not immediately available.
